css.description: CSS applied to supplied HTML or injected into a captured webpage.

url.description: Absolute, internet-reachable HTTP(S) webpage URL to capture. Set this or html, but not both; use headers for authenticated pages.

html.description: HTML to render. Set this or url, but not both.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to the captured page, with at most 20 case-insensitive names.

ms_delay.description: Extra render delay in milliseconds, from 0 to 10000. Zero omits the explicit delay.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to capture.

timezone.description: IANA timezone exposed to the rendered page.

media_type.description: CSS media type used while rendering: screen or print.

full_screen.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of only the viewport.

max_wait_ms.description: Maximum wait from 500 to 10000 milliseconds for page loading.

color_scheme.description: Preferred browser color scheme: light or dark.

google_fonts.description: Google Font family names to load while rendering.

viewport_width.description: Viewport width in pixels, from 1 to 6000. Requires viewport_height.

viewport_height.description: Viewport height in pixels. Requires viewport_width.

dedupe_duration_s.description: Reuse a matching recent render for this many seconds. Allowed durations depend on the account plan; free accounts accept 0 or 2592000 (30 days).

render_when_ready.description: Wait until the page signals that rendering is ready.

block_consent_banners.description: Attempt to block common consent banners.

transparent_background.description: Render a transparent background where supported.

additional_header_origins.description: Up to 20 unique exact HTTP(S) origins that may also receive headers.

include_headers_on_subrequests.description: Also include supplied headers on page subrequests.
